What this project does
Moosic Atlas applies unsupervised machine learning to 5,235 Spotify songs. Using 9 audio features per song — no genre labels, no artist names, no popularity scores — K-Means clustering groups songs into 5 musically coherent personalities. The result is a music map built entirely from mathematics.
The data — 9 audio features per song
Every feature is a number computed by Spotify's audio analysis engine from the raw waveform. All 9 were standardised (zero mean, unit variance) before feeding the model — so no single feature dominates just because of its numerical scale.
FeatureRangeWhat it measures
Energy0 – 1Perceptual intensity — metal scores high, lullabies score low
Danceability0 – 1Rhythm stability and beat regularity — how suitable for dancing
Valence0 – 1Musical positivity — happy/euphoric high, sad/angry low
Acousticness0 – 1Confidence the track uses acoustic (not electronic) instruments
TempoBPM → 0–1Beats per minute, normalised to the same scale as all other features
LoudnessdB → 0–1Average loudness across the track, normalised
Instrumentalness0 – 1Predicts absence of vocals — orchestral near 1, songs with lyrics near 0
Liveness0 – 1Detects live audience — studio recording low, live concert high
Speechiness0 – 1Amount of spoken word — rap/podcast high, pure melody near 0
Algorithm selection — three algorithms tested
Three clustering algorithms competed on the same data. K-Means won — highest silhouette score, 100% song coverage, and zero noise points.
MethodClustersNoiseCoverageSilhouetteNotes
K-Meanschosen50100%0.267k=5, k-means++, n_init=10, random_state=42
Agglomerative (Ward)50100%0.220Good dendrogram structure, slightly weaker cluster separation
DBSCAN7 (at best)93182%−0.022eps=1.0, min_samples=5 — 17.8% songs unassigned as noise
Silhouette score comparison
Silhouette score measures how well each song fits its own cluster vs. the nearest other cluster. Range: −1 (wrong cluster) to +1 (perfect fit). Above 0.2 is considered good for music data.
Why DBSCAN failed on this data
DBSCAN requires dense islands of data separated by empty space. Spotify's audio feature space is continuous — music blends gradually from metal to rock to pop with no empty gaps. At eps=0.5: 30 clusters, 93% noise. At eps=1.0: 7 clusters, 18% noise. At eps=1.5: only 2 clusters. No eps value produced a stable, complete result. K-Means doesn't need gaps — it partitions the space directly.
Choosing k = 5 — the Elbow Method
K-Means requires choosing k upfront. We tested k = 2 through 8 and measured both inertia (tightness) and silhouette score (separation quality).
Why not k = 2? Why not k = 6?
  • k=2 (score 0.333) — highest silhouette but splits the library into only two groups: aggressive vs mellow. Too coarse to be musically useful.
  • k=5 (score 0.267) — the last k where silhouette stays above 0.265 AND produces musically distinct, nameable groups. The "elbow" of diminishing returns.
  • k=6+ (score ≤ 0.248) — silhouette drops and new clusters are micro-fragments of existing ones, not new music personalities.
Audio fingerprints — all 5 clusters
Each radar polygon shows the average value of all 9 features for that cluster. The shape IS the cluster's musical identity. Compare shapes to see what makes each group distinct.

Key findings & technical notes
  • No genre labels were used. The algorithm found musically coherent groups from numbers alone — validating that Spotify's audio features are genuine mathematical fingerprints of sound.
  • Standardisation was critical. Without it, tempo (range 60–200 BPM) would dominate danceability (range 0–1) purely due to scale, not musical relevance.
  • Three 3D projections (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP) all show the same 5 clusters as separated groups — confirming the separation is real in 9D space, not an artefact of any single visualisation method.
  • Speechiness separates Hip-Hop & R&B. It is the most distinctive single feature for cluster 5 — rap and R&B contain significantly more spoken-word content than any other group.
  • The Atlas drafts; a person listens. Audio features cannot capture lyrics, language, cultural context, or era. Human judgement remains essential.
